scope: Approve the exact V4 sheet as the visual authority for the fitted cabinetry state family.
Approve the depicted Sink On/Broken, Dishwasher On/Broken, Oven Off/Broken and Fridge standard/Broken state art.
Approve the closed state semantics for inherited Off/On bodies and the independently blinking red dishwasher fault lights.
Preserve the approved cabinetry-body foundation byte-for-byte beneath later production extraction.
notApproved: transparent production-layer extraction or sprite-atlas crops
animation implementation or timing beyond the declared semantics
logical-size registration, native-scale game proof or runtime wiring
collision, interaction, placement or production-selector changes
rollback: Supersede with a new versioned state authority; the approved V1 bytes, production sprites and runtime remain untouched.
